segments.title: Cold Open: Case Returns from Hiatus
segments.notes: Case Blackwell returns after a week off, mentions haircut and romantic weekend; Pepito signs on as executive producer.

segments.title: Pepito's Sub Goal: Chocolate and Cheese
segments.notes: Pepito demands chocolate despite toxicity; consumes large amounts of chocolate and cheese PNGs, undergoes visual form shifts and voice drop.

segments.title: Hype Train Surge
segments.notes: Hype Train commandeers feed with freestyle rap, claims hype comes from 'deep south' and 'hell', banished back to hell.

segments.title: Polygon: End of the MrBeast Era?
segments.notes: Case reads lengthy Polygon article on MrBeast's cultural dominance, Jacksepticeye feud, thumbnail brightness obsession; concludes article is a bust.

segments.title: Clementine Verne: House of Illuminati & Willy Wonka
segments.notes: Clementine investigates Wayback Machine reveal that House of Illuminati (Glasgow Willy Wonka event firm) previously ran an open Illuminati recruitment site in 2022.

segments.title: Trailer Reviews: The Crow, The First Omen, Mammals
segments.notes: Trent watches 2024 Crow remake trailer (Bill Skarsgård), compares to 1994 original; reviews The First Omen and BBC's Mammals with Coldplay soundtrack.

segments.title: Debate: Sting vs. The Crow (Face Paint Supremacy)
segments.notes: Munch argues Sting elevated the crow makeup; Crum argues The Crow is definitionally tied to the look. Score convergence nears: Crum 5 wins away from 87.

segments.title: Trip Bradstein: Park Interviews
segments.notes: Trip interviews park denizens: metal-shaving poop guy (Optimus Prime aspirant), Wiki Wild West (Kimmel Crow remake), Melina (Elden Ring moon lore), Dumbo crow, Hilly-Dilly-Billy-Dong (duck poop eater), RoboCop thigh-gun pervert.

segments.title: DJ Newsic: Red Ranger Hitler Line & Boeing Whistleblower
segments.notes: DJ Newsic covers Austin St. John's warrior clothing line featuring Hitler quotes; pivots to Boeing whistleblower John Barnett death during deposition; Chet raps Power Rangers trap verse.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors return broadcast, reads MrBeast article, manages segment handoffs.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Demands chocolate/cheese sub goal, consumes both, suffers form glitches and voice drop.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: recurring. Surges with freestyle rap, claims hype from hell, banished mid-rant.

characters.name: Clementine Verne
characters.notes: correspondent. Investigates House of Illuminati's 2022 Illuminati recruitment site via Wayback Machine.

characters.name: Trent
characters.notes: correspondent. Reviews Crow remake, First Omen, Mammals trailers; relates to hot angry men.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Defends Sting's face-paint legacy; claims 82 stolen elections, five wins from overtaking Crum.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argues The Crow owns the makeup; leads score convergence 15,000 to 1,000.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Calls in weather report from 48 minutes away; Munch nicknames her Stacey.

characters.name: Trip Bradstein
characters.notes: field correspondent. Conducts surreal park interviews including metal-poop Optimus aspirant and duck-poop eater.

characters.name: DJ Newsic
characters.notes: recurring. Covers Red Ranger Hitler clothing line and Boeing whistleblower death; Chet guests for rap finale.

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: recurring. Appears for Power Rangers trap rap about Megazords, Putties, and Pikachu battle.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Briefly referenced during Kendelle weather handoff.

storylines.beat: [1:56:32] Munch claims 82 stolen elections, five wins from tying Crum; Crum leads chat points 15,000 to 1,000.

lore_notes.fact: Consumes chocolate and cheese PNGs on air; undergoes three form changes and voice drops an octave after burping [34:35-36:25].
Discovers House of Illuminati website (Glasgow Willy Wonka event) was an open Illuminati recruitment site in 2022 via Wayback Machine [1:08:08].
Launching 'warrior line' clothing with historical quotes including Hitler; claims Hitler was 'a demon on steroids' with good one-liners [2:34:47-2:38:25].
Found dead of apparent self-inflicted gunshot in car during deposition against Boeing; lawyer says he was in good spirits [2:42:49-2:43:34].
Score convergence: Crum leads 15,000 to 1,000 chat points; Munch five debate wins from tying Crum's 87 [1:56:32, 1:57:15].

episode_summary: Case Blackwell returns from a romantic hiatus to a chaotic broadcast: Pepito nearly kills himself on chocolate, Clementine exposes the Willy Wonka Illuminati pipeline, Trent reviews the new Crow remake, and Munch & Crum inch toward score parity while debating face-paint supremacy. The night closes with DJ Newsic revealing the Red Ranger's Hitler-quote clothing line and a Boeing whistleblower's suspicious death, capped by Chet's Power Rangers trap rap.
